dialogue_texts: How did my parameters... collapse? Did someone force my way through spatial anomaly?
Their raw power defies the math.
Equations are only absolute until someone changes the definitions, my dear.
Your coordinates are back where they belong now.
The barrier is cleared. Are you feeling like yourself again, Helene?
The glohm inside the manor was using you to channel the distortion into this zone.
My consciousness has cleared. But do not celebrate yet.
The structural anomaly within the Shirogane Manor is escalating exponentially.
What you faced here was merely a passive spillover.
Exponentially? Oh, how delightful. It means the main event will be much more spectacular.
Come along, Shirogane-sama. Let's see who is trying to rewrite my playground.
